name: AH-7921
metabolism: Non-fentanyl new synthetic opioid analogues such as AH-7921 follow demethylation, as U-47700, for which N-desmethyl, N,N-didesmethyl, desmethylhydroxy and N,N-didesmethylhydroxy metabolites in urine have been detected.
summary: AH-7921 is an opioid analgesic selective for the μ-opioid receptor. It has been sold online as a new psychoactive substance and has not progressed to clinical trials.
